**9-Lesson mini-course** — TensorFlow 2.x / Keras 3 end to end — tensors, tf.data pipelines, training loops, CNNs, transfer learning, and deployment to Serving/TFLite.

Like every course on this site, each lesson is a deep, code-first lesson: an intuition-first explainer, a staged code walkthrough explaining the methodology line by line, visuals, and a **🧪 Your task** exercise with a hidden solution. Theory lives in the [AI & ML Encyclopedia](../../ai-ml-encyclopedia.html); here you build.
